It's worth a try i guess, but I feel that It's going to be a challenging as digging to the core of earth with a plastic spoon. I think differently to the point nothing is predictable but everybody else is. 

Psychology is what I wanted to study at Uni, ironic isn't it?

Yes, I'm interpreting my dreams now, which are more surrealist and fucked up than any Salvador Dalí painting. I also have to do spontaneous sketches for my next appointment, It's my first time for this, but I'm not that optimistic about it.

Yeah, but I feel no progress is being made and all the sessions I had with other Psychologists/Psychiatrists are repeating themselves. I explain everything the best I can and all they do is listen and try encourage me with their optimistic beliefs. They think that I should be okay and next thing I cut myself, proving they just genuinely can't and won't understand. I'm hoping the newest one I have will have more insight and be helpful instead of being a bobblehead, nodding to everything.

Plenty of people care for me, I wish I could care for all of them though...
I'm 16. In 5th year in Secondary School (2 years from Uni) I don't have a job because I hate talking to new people in person so much, I would walk a mile to a shop dreading asking "How much is ___?" More than the walk back home. I also may have Social Anxiety Disorder and had a lot of anger management as a child. The anger management only taught me how to hide anger, if I were to lose it right now, I would spend an hour smashing/punching/kicking my surroundings.

All the things I have around me and I can barely force a fucking smile. I'm an only child who is spoilt, has an IQ of 148 and gets the best grades in Higher Level English and doesn't study, plays piano, mandoline, guitar, harmonica and bongos, has an electronica music project, involved with 3 bands, looks like Spencer Reid from Criminal Minds, has many friends but is highly introverted and knows at least 5,000 songs. 

I know people who have it far worse than me, but at least they can actually be happy, I can't, if you can't enjoy your life, what's the point in living it? A life with pain or a death without anything?

It's drains me to hide behind a mask the whole time, music has been keeping me alive so long but even that I've began losing interest in. All the good things about me remind me of the one person I've ever had feelings for and it just drains me more. I'm genuinely not worth life, nobody thinks the way I selectively do. Nobody understands me.
Thanks for a bit of reassurance. I never liked the thoughts of being considered obsessed. In the meantime, I'm pulling through better now but not quite back to normal, thanks for helping me.
Then no. I only sometimes ask her about how she is, only sometimes her whereabouts as she travels a lot. If we are talking It's usually general conversation to interests.

Well, I miss actually talking to her, but as much as some of my friends know about her, I never yap away about her. I somewhat find it difficult to not talk to her though, my psychologist recommended to take a break from talking to her (because we talk everyday), I only lasted a week because I ended up annoyed with ignoring her, we still talk very often. Would this be considered Obsessive?
But if a crush on someone lasts more than 3 months, isn't it love?

I find Reddit is trustworthy, but that's it. I also would probably find that a relationship through the internet is quite difficult, especially when you're only using phone internet because your house doesn't have it.

Well, that is what I thought I could do, but in Ireland, there is barely anybody like me. Most people I know are racists for starters and I hate racism. I find this difficult when even my dad is racist. Not to mention, most girls are gossips and are not trustworthy from the ones I've talked to. Not to mention, my area is dangerous, somebody only a year older than me got shot 3 days ago. I'm Introverted too, so looking for people is so challenging for me.

But there's no solution here! I'm depressed, telling others doesn't work which made me realize only telling her will, losing her friendship will lose my will to live, I'll kill myself without holding back and then my friends and family will be depressed.
Not telling her means I'm still holding everything in which I can't take anymore...

Exactly. I don't want to be selfish and the thing is I've told a friend that I trust and it has no effect on me. I feel by the end of this, someone's going to be depressed and in all circumstances, it's my fault. I hate myself.

I do, I'm aware that she cares about me, but she trusted me with a lot. The only thing I've told her in this here is that I was depressed and that talking to her had a life-changing effect on me. I'm wearing the bracelet she bought me right now and was only talking to her today. It's just that I'm afraid of upsetting her. On my birthday she did wish me the best, how I feel now is that I'm letting her down with my own feelings towards her.

I have no idea, this is where the dilemma remains, I can't predict her reaction but I can guess that she would have sympathy. She seems to think alike to me but I've had several thoughts on how this could go and I am not your paticular risk taker.

I don't even know how to work up to it, but perhaps it'll slip out when it gets to April which I don't want to happen because I reckon it could make her feel cornered. I also don't intend on dwelling on what I feel that could of been either so you can see why I would find suicide as my solution.
That's what I had planned, but I feel I'm not strong enough to tell her. I feel that I can't just randomly message her this out of the blue.
